conditions.note: Copied from the RDAT ANNOTATION line; cross-checked against the file at run time.

mask_reason: 3' primer-binding tail (AAAGAAACAACAACAACAAC): reactivities ~1e-4, no structural information. Stored as numbers in the RDAT, set to NaN here.

report_notes.construct: P4-P6 domain of the Tetrahymena group I intron (RDAT NAME: 'P4-P6 domain, Tetrahymena ribozyme'), mutate-and-map experiment (DMS, MaP readout); only the wild-type row is used.
report_notes.region: R = 100-140 (RDAT numbering) contains the 5' arms of P4 (107-112) and P5 (116-121) and the start of P5a (127-138); their partners lie at 200-214 and 180-195, i.e. outside small 5'-anchored windows. This mimics the mRNA use case (5'-anchored window growing toward 3').
data_caveats: Positions 90-92 have reactivity exactly 0 and 93-99 are near 0 (possible low read coverage near the 5' end); they lie outside R and do not enter E.
Low DMS signal in the first positions of R (100-103) is part of E; it may reflect coverage rather than structure.
limitations: P4-P6 is not an mRNA: the test validates the method, but choosing a window for mRNAs requires mRNA probing data.
P4-P6 forms an extensive Mg2+-dependent tertiary structure (A-rich bulge, tetraloop/receptor), which none of the models capture.
